title: Crush the Jar Festival
competitors: Knock the Blocks (one player launches objects at a Jenga tower) – 85.6M visits, '2K playing' – robloxgames.org, undated; Destroy the Tower (Jenga + destruction physics, 50 players) – visits not surfaced – roblox.com, undated; devforum cannon-vs-tower game (tiny) – devforum, 2025
demand_check: verified: Smash Fest! ranked No.1 worldwide by downloads in July 2026 (Sensor Tower July 2026 blog)
red_flags: physics destruction replication/lag with 4 players on one tower; weekly player-designed tower needs build moderation; RNG golden jars for cosmetics only
why: Mobile demand is real, but tower-smash physics already exists on Roblox (Knock the Blocks 85.6M) and the co-op cosmetic loop earns like a party game.
pivot: Make each smashed jar drop a rolled collectible (pets/relics with mutations) into a permanent collection with luck/shot-upgrade painkillers, so it becomes a collection game instead of a party round.

title: Crack the Password Rules

red_flags: free-text entry must go through TextService filtering (hashtags break rules); player-authored custom rules = text moderation risk; sponsor-brand rules = IP

title: Hide in the Mess
competitors: Hide or OOF! (prop hunt) – 803,089,527 visits – Rolimons, undated; Hide and Seek Transform – 173,695,934 visits – Rolimons, undated; Prop Hunt Hide and Seek / Flow's Prop Hunt – visits not surfaced; Wash The House – 11,978,092 visits, 31,460 playing – Rolimons, ~Aug 2026; Dig & Clean – 16.7M visits, ~27.8K CCU Aug 7 2026; no cleaning-themed prop hunt found
demand_check: verified: cleaning (Wash The House 31.5K CCU) and prop hunt (Hide or OOF! 803M visits) both proven
red_flags: needs several real hiders + cleaners (weak bot fallback); round-based party format earns ~18% of collection games
why: The mashup itself is unoccupied and clip-friendly, but prop hunt is a mega-occupied format and the design as written is a cosmetic-only party round.
pivot: Make cleaning the persistent core (every non-player mess pile rolls a rarity loot item for a collection, Dig & Clean-style) with player-hiders as a bonus 'catch' jackpot, so it earns and works in half-empty servers.
